_comment: Add new event objects to the events array. Required fields: title, startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), time (display text such as '4:00PM', 'All Day', or 'TBD'), location, and description. For multi-day events, add endDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional button: {label, href, variant}; optional links: [{label, href}]. Use a named accent color that can map to a site theme, not arbitrary CSS. Omit optional fields when unused.
